title: Ethics and privacy: what you see and what you do not repeat

videos.script: To fix things, a technician is given more access than anyone else in the organisation. On most computers, one command opens every folder, every printed page and every log. {{access}} Nothing on the computer decides what you look at with that access. You do. {{you}} This lesson shows how much a support account can reach on an ordinary office computer, including a copy of something a person printed. And it shows what the computer writes down about you while you look. {{lab}} Then it goes through what a technician does with what they see, which is mostly: nothing, and tell no one. {{nothing}}
